name: OTel-Collector
introduction: BK-Lite APM regional collector. Receives OTLP traces from application probes on 4317/gRPC and 4318/HTTP, sanitizes them with trace_guard, and publishes them to the NATS JetStream subject apm.traces.<cloud_region_id> for the system collector to write into VictoriaTraces.

default_config.nats:
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
  file_storage:
    directory: /opt/fusion-collectors/cache/apm-queue
    create_directory: true
    timeout: 1s
    compaction:
      directory: /opt/fusion-collectors/cache/apm-queue
      on_start: true

receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
        max_recv_msg_size_mib: 8
        include_metadata: true
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
        include_metadata: true
        max_request_body_size: 8388608

processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 384
    spike_limit_mib: 96
  trace_guard:
    cloud_region_id: "${node.cloud_region}"
    max_resource_attributes: 64
    max_scope_attributes: 32
    max_span_attributes: 100
    max_event_attributes: 32
    max_link_attributes: 32
    max_attribute_runes: 4096
  batch/traces:
    timeout: 2s
    send_batch_size: 256
    send_batch_max_size: 512

exporters:
  nats_jetstream:
    urls: ["${NATS_PROTOCOL}://${NATS_USERNAME}:${env:NATS_PASSWORD}@${NATS_SERVERS}"]
    subject: apm.traces.${node.cloud_region}
    connect_timeout: 5s
    timeout: 10s
    max_message_bytes: 8388608
{% if NATS_PROTOCOL == "tls" %}
    tls:
      ca_file: "${NATS_TLS_CA_FILE}"
      insecure_skip_verify: false
{% endif %}
    sending_queue:
      enabled: true
      sizer: bytes
      queue_size: 1073741824
      num_consumers: 4
      block_on_overflow: false
      storage: file_storage
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 1s
      max_interval: 30s
      max_elapsed_time: 0s

service:
  extensions: [health_check, file_storage]
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: normal
      readers:
        - pull:
            exporter:
              prometheus:
                host: 0.0.0.0
                port: 8888
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors:
        - memory_limiter
        - trace_guard
        - batch/traces
      exporters: [nats_jetstream]
